record.original_question: An MSTD subset of the integers has more pairwise sums than pairwise differences. Starting from the minimal 8-element integer example, one can build an MSTD subset of Z^2 by taking its product with a 2-point set. Can one instead construct an MSTD subset of Z^2 directly, without obtaining it from an MSTD subset of Z by such a lifting procedure?

evidence.quote: If look in Z2, can construct an MSTD set of size 16 from this: take A × {0, 1} (any set of size two would work). Can you construct MSTD sets in Z2 without going through an MSTD set in Z.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a finite subset $A$ of an abelian group, define the sumset $A+A=\{a+b:a,b\in A\}$ and the difference set $A-A=\{a-b:a,b\in A\}$. The set $A$ is called MSTD ("more sums than differences") if $|A+A|>|A-A|$.

It is known that there exist MSTD subsets of $\mathbb{Z}$ (the smallest having $8$ elements). From any MSTD set $A\subset\mathbb{Z}$ one can produce an MSTD subset of $\mathbb{Z}^2$ by taking the Cartesian product $A\times B$ with any $2$-element set $B\subset\mathbb{Z}$.

Construct an MSTD subset $S\subset\mathbb{Z}^2$ that does not arise from this lifting procedure; that is, exhibit a finite set $S\subset\mathbb{Z}^2$ with $|S+S|>|S-S|$ which is not of the form $\varphi(A\times B)$ for any MSTD set $A\subset\mathbb{Z}$, any finite $B\subset\mathbb{Z}$ with $|B|\ge 2$, and any affine isomorphism $\varphi$ of $\mathbb{Z}^2$ (more generally, $S$ should not be obtainable from a one-dimensional MSTD set via such a product/lifting construction).
artifact.status_search_result: Subsequent work on MSTD sets in higher dimensions has produced direct constructions of MSTD subsets of $\mathbb{Z}^2$ that are not obtained as products of one-dimensional MSTD sets with a 2-point set. In particular, results in "Constructions of generalized MSTD sets in higher dimensions" (arXiv:2009.02758) and related work give explicit families of MSTD sets in $\mathbb{Z}^d$ for $d\ge 2$ built directly from higher-dimensional fringe constructions, and it is shown that a positive proportion of random subsets of an $n\times n$ grid in $\mathbb{Z}^2$ are MSTD, providing many examples not arising from a one-dimensional lift.

status_evidence.title: Constructions of Generalized MSTD Sets in Higher Dimensions
status_evidence.snippet: Constructions of generalized MSTD sets in higher dimensions, including 2-dimensional generalizations and chains of generalized MSTD sets.
status_evidence.claim: Direct higher-dimensional MSTD constructions exist that generalize beyond products of 1-dimensional MSTD sets.

status_evidence.title: Sets characterized by missing sums and differences in dilating polytopes
status_evidence.snippet: A uniformly random subset of {0,...,n}^d has positive probability of being MSTD, providing many MSTD sets in Z^d directly.
status_evidence.claim: Random subsets of Z^2 grids are MSTD with positive probability, yielding direct MSTD sets in Z^2.
